reference.how: the same build and frame with TE_GFX_NO_SHADOWS=1 (the volumes counted, the composite skipped): the caster's own luminance without any shadow

why: The shadow caster (the reported hub / Jungle Bungle screenshots): the shadow composite darkened Crash's own body -- dark blotches on his back, arm and legs -- because the port counted the volume strips wherever a face lay at or behind the scene depth, caster included (half his body lies behind his own volume's front face). The retail StartShadows seeds the half-size buffer's alpha from the frame's alpha and counts a strip only where that alpha's top bit is 0 (DATE, DATM 0): the lit world writes alpha 0x7E and receives the shadow, a skin writes 0x80 and never does. Present 2900 of the hub pad log (Crash idle on the beach, turned to the right, the camera behind him): his torso box within 5 of the shadows-off reference and at most 6 % near-black, his legs within 8 of the reference, and the footprint still on the sand beside his shoes (the ring beside it 15..70 brighter). The oracle's frame is not region-comparable (NTSC 512x448, a different disc and alignment), so the reference is the same build with the composite off.
